answer: Milestone bond: a newcomer locks 70 credits and must pass three milestones in six epochs, each stamped on a reef chart. Each pass earns an ivory stamp, freeing a third of the bond. A mirror review checks each milestone against earlier stamps; rented work burns the bond. Forging 1,000 identities means 3,000 milestones at 25 credits each: 75,000 against a 40,000 pool, plus 70,000 in lost bonds. An honest agent pays 70 once and keeps its share.
